title: Arab banking giants: 12 banks account for 50.46% of top 200 assets
credit: FirstBank publication coverage — individual byline not verified
summary: A close look at concentration in the Arab banking market. Twelve institutions together held USD 2.86tn in assets at the end of June 2026, accounting for just over half the assets represented in FirstBank’s ranking of the 200 largest operating banks in the region.

title: Arab banking leadership race tightens as FAB closes in on QNB
credit: FirstBank publication coverage — individual byline not verified
summary: An examination of the narrowing asset gap between Qatar National Bank and First Abu Dhabi Bank following their third-quarter 2026 results. The comparison frames a regional leadership contest through the financial positions of two large Gulf banking groups.

title: FirstBank tracks UAE’s 10 largest banks in the Arab top 100
credit: FirstBank publication coverage — individual byline not verified
summary: FirstBank’s ranking of the Arab world’s 100 largest banks at the end of June 2026 included 17 UAE institutions. This article focuses on the ten largest UAE banks in that regional comparison and their place within the broader Arab banking landscape.

title: The Big Numbers Race: ANB, QIB compete for the Arab top 20
credit: FirstBank publication coverage — individual byline not verified
summary: A focused comparison between Saudi Arabia’s Arab National Bank and Qatar Islamic Bank near the threshold of the top twenty Arab banks. FirstBank’s first-half 2026 data put ANB twentieth and QIB twenty-first.

title: The Big Numbers Race: Four banks battle for Arab top 30 lenders spot
credit: FirstBank publication coverage — individual byline not verified
summary: An analysis of competition around thirtieth place among the region’s largest banks by lending. The comparison includes Emirates Islamic and Commercial Bank of Qatar, examining how differences in loan growth may affect the ranking.

title: FirstBank unveils first-ever ranking of 200 largest banks operating in Arab region
credit: FirstBank publication coverage — individual byline not verified
summary: The inaugural ranking compares banks operating across Arab markets on the basis of assets expressed in US dollars. It covers local banks, foreign banks and international subsidiaries, offering a wider picture of the regional banking system.

title: NBK to launch NBK Wealth for wealth management solutions
summary: Reporting on the National Bank of Kuwait’s announcement of a unified wealth-management brand. The initiative brings together private banking, investment management and brokerage services across the group’s wider international network.

title: Egypt, Saudi Arabia ink deal for fertiliser production in Nubaria
summary: The Egyptian Agricultural Research Centre and a Saudi agricultural development company reached an agreement covering fertiliser and soil-enhancer production in Nubaria. The announcement also outlined ambitions for training and technical cooperation.

title: Egypt explores transport cooperation with Saudi Arabia
summary: Reporting on discussions between Egyptian and Saudi transport ministers about closer cooperation in manufacturing, infrastructure and cross-border transport. Potential participation by Egyptian companies in Saudi projects was among the subjects raised.

title: Egypt’s TE, Oman’s ZOI to build digital corridor
summary: Telecom Egypt and Zain-Omantel International announced plans for a regional digital corridor connecting Oman’s coast to Egypt’s Mediterranean network using terrestrial and subsea fibre infrastructure.

title: Embracing renewables: the economic upswing of green energy ’24
summary: A feature examining the economic case for renewable energy and the financial implications of the transition to cleaner power sources. It provides a wider policy and market lens beyond day-to-day announcements.

title: Egypt, EU sign €1bn financial aid pact
summary: Coverage of a financial-assistance agreement between Egypt and the European Union, situating the announcement within the two sides’ broader economic and investment relationship.

title: Egypt signs green hydrogen production deal in Sokhna
summary: A report on a green hydrogen agreement at Sokhna involving the Sovereign Fund of Egypt, Orascom Construction, Scatec and Abu Dhabi-listed Fertiglobe. The planned 100 MW facility forms part of Egypt’s emerging clean-fuels sector.
